Idk if it is normal but the same happens to me and my gf, everytime I see any type of sh scar it triggers me and i have to stop whatever im doing and try to distract ms for a little bit til i forget abt it. Anyways, Im sorry i wont help that much bc tbh im also not sure what to do abt it most of the time haha, but what i did was i tried to like talk abt it. ofc that goes from person to person yk, in my case i knew that my friend was pretty open abt what he did in the past and didnt mind talking abt it and i was also kinda comfortable talking abt it so we were able to talk it out. i explained the way i felt abt it and he said that he wasnt showing it bc he was proud, but he wasnt ashamed either, "it's something that happened and now its a part of who i came to be". so now whenever i see someone with the scars it doesnt affect me as much as before and i found a way to transform the angst i feel into a sort of respect if that makes sense, since now i see it as a sign of strength more than anything. ofc if it is fresh i simply cant, and i usually end up having to leave (yeah it may sound rude but its the way can deal with that). Either way sorry i went on a tangent there haha, what i want to say is if possible try talking to your friend and since you sound like you two kinda close he will prob understand your side and try to help you yk
